Overview.Name: Tammewar Nitin
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Reducing thyroid and pre-diabetic issues, Reducing belly fat, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Mostly vegetarian with eggs, avoids eggs on Thursday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) + tomato curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Reduce sweets, fried foods and late-night eating to support blood sugar control and belly fat reduction.
Keep meals simple and avoid overeating during social gatherings.
Morning sunlight exposure can improve thyroid balance, sleep quality and energy levels.
Short walks after meals and regular yoga will help improve digestion and glucose control.
Since leafy vegetables are disliked, include other simple cooked vegetables regularly.
